commentary: Today the most-traded iron ore contract I2605 conƟnued to ﬂuctuate upward, closing at 768 yuan/mt, up 1.25% from the previous working day. Traders acƟvely sold goods, while steel mills cauƟously waited and purchased as needed. TransacƟons were mainly driven by steel mill procurement, and the trading atmosphere was sluggish. In Shandong, the transacƟon price of PB ﬁnes was 783-790 yuan/mt, up 3-5 yuan/mt from the previous day; in Hebei, the transacƟon price of PB ﬁnes was 795-803 yuan/mt, up 3-5 yuan/mt from the previous day. According to the SMM survey, on December 17, the blast furnace operaƟng rate at the 242 steel mills surveyed by SMM was 84.64%, down 0.59 percentage points MoM. The daily average hot metal producƟon at the sample steel mills was 2.3477 Mt, down 14,200 mt MoM. Recently, aﬀected by environmental protecƟon-driven producƟon restricƟons in the north, some steel mills halted blast furnaces for maintenance or idling, leading to a conƟnued decline in hot metal producƟon. The fundamental supply-demand picture for iron ore remains weak. However, considering the short-term producƟon decline, which beneﬁts steel prices, and the current recovery in steel mill proﬁts, market pessimism has eased somewhat, driving a slight rebound in ore prices.
